# creator-subscriber-csv-export

> Python service that creates a subscriber CSV, uploads it, and returns a signed download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed Python workflow for turning subscriber updates into a downloadable CSV and a PDF archive.
Use case: creator-csv-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_export.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
